title: Affine chart tensor comparison via a bijective structural-linear map
statement: Under the hypotheses of new-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-tensor-sections, there exists a C-linear map e from FormalGlueing.extend φ (FormalGlueing.piece f (chartSectionModule (q ≫ U.ι) f)) to the structural section module N on s⁻¹D(φ(f)) that is bijective.

proof.text: Restrict the overlap isomorphism to the pullback of the affine principal chart and apply the affine fibre-product tensor formula; transport the resulting C-linear map to the completed principal open. The transported map is bijective because the overlap restriction and affine tensor comparison are bijections.

lean.statement: theorem exists_chart_tensor_sections_bijective {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine E] {s : E ⟶ Spec (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A) (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U) (hV : IsAffineOpen ((q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A let φ := algebraMap A C let W := s ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (φ f) letI : Module C Γ(E, W) := Module.compHom _ ((ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop ≫ E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op).hom let N := ModuleCat.of C Γ(E, W) ∃ e : FormalGlueing.extend φ (FormalGlueing.piece f (chartSectionModule (q ≫ U.ι) f)) →ₗ[C] N, Function.Bijective e
